# Special use (295-201-619)
   619.      SPECIAL USE means a use which is generally acceptable in a particular zoning district but
which, because of its characteristics and the characteristics of the zoning district in which it would be
located, requires review on a case-by-case basis to determine whether it should be permitted, conditionally
permitted or denied.

# Variance (dimensional) (295-201-675)
   675.    VARIANCE, DIMENSIONAL means permission from the board to depart from any of the literal
requirements of this chapter except use regulations, including but not limited to a departure from an area,
setback, frontage, height, bulk, density or design requirement.

# Variance (use) (295-201-676)
   676.    VARIANCE, USE means permission from the board to depart from any of the use regulations of
this chapter.
